appearance_facts.fact: A single dark red line chart spans the full width of the graph from left to right.
The line begins at a vertical position corresponding to approximately 1200 on the y-axis.

appearance_facts.location: Center to right side of plot area
appearance_facts.fact: The line shows a general upward trajectory, rising significantly from the 2017 mark to a peak in 2022.
The line reaches its highest vertical point in 2022, appearing to be above the 3200 grid line.
The line ends in 2023 at a vertical position slightly lower than the 2022 peak but still well above the 3200 grid line.
The line is continuous and unbroken, connecting annual data points from 2012 through 2023.
Faint horizontal grid lines are visible at regular intervals behind the data line.
The vertical position of the line at the far right (2023) is substantially higher on the page than the vertical position at the far left (2012).
